title: FLUX: Fast Software-based Communication Overlap On GPUs Through Kernel Fusion
technique: fine-grained communication-computation overlap by kernel fusion

optimized_metrics.evidence: up to 1.66x and 1.30x speedups for prefill and decoding inference over vLLM

headline_claim.text: it can achieve up to 1.24x speedups for training over Megatron-LM on a cluster of 128 GPUs with various GPU generations and interconnects, and up to 1.66x and 1.30x speedups for prefill and decoding inference over vLLM

extractor_notes: Abstract-only extraction. "speedups" unspecified; paper targets hiding communication latency ("up to 96% of communication").
